rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for adopting a child.

example.english: My adoption by that family happened when I was little.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣畀嗰家人領養。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 bei2 go2 gaa1 jan4 ling5 joeng5

rows.note: Use this for adopting a word, method, system, or other practical choice.

example.english: After the company's adoption of the new system, work got faster.
example.traditional: 公司採用新制度之後，做嘢快咗。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 coi2 jung6 san1 zai3 dou6 zi1 hau6 zou6 je5 faai3 zo2

rows.note: Use this for accepting an opinion, belief, or idea as one's own.

example.english: My adoption of this idea took a while.
example.traditional: 我用咗一段時間先接受呢個諗法。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 zo2 jat1 dyun6 si4 gaan3 sin1 zip3 sau6 ni1 go3 nam2 faat3

rows.note: Use this formal term when an authority or group adopts a proposal or opinion.

example.english: The committee announced its formal adoption of this proposal yesterday.
example.traditional: 委員會噚日宣布正式採納呢項建議。
example.jyutping: wai2 jyun4 wui6 cam4 jat6 syun1 bou3 zing3 sik1 coi2 naap6 ni1 hong6 gin3 ji5
